evidence: Both negative cases are pectoral_muscular/breast/centerOFF; canonical A measurements, no diagnostic substitution and no out-of-range/extrapolation.

Actual nearest A50 is shorter than C and is NOT the cumulative-best baseline: C improves over nearest A50 by >3pp in each case. A45 is shorter still and covers more than A50, so its coverage persists at the A50 length envelope knot.
C positive-X outer line x=-38.652mm, actual A positive-X boundary line x=-25.400mm (C reaches 13.252mm less toward positive-X/medial boundary).

C negative-X outer line x=-135.04mm exists only y=340..428mm (length95.6mm); A negative-X x~-116.99mm extends y=301.64..451.99mm (none243.36mm; realistic224.60mm in two fragments). C spends a strip on a farther-out short lateral piece while leaving positive-X/end boundary footprint area uncovered.

Actual A45 comparison shows >99.8% of area A covers but C misses lies in projected ROI-boundary20mm zone; C gains interior/negative-X coverage but loses positive-X boundary coverage. Location flag alone is not a proved causal decomposition of the interpolated envelope.
C maximum residual hole diameter18.92/18.17mm is <20mm, yet integrated uncovered area can still make efficiency gain negative. Hole-count threshold and coverage area are distinct metrics.
cause_analysis.interpretation: C-only boundary placement and strip extents explain geometric deficit; the stronger negative at equal budget is a measured-A envelope interpolation, not a same-budget executed A path.
cause_analysis.covariance_limit: These are observed spatial contributions, not controlled root-cause ablations; no new path or contact measurement was fabricated.

heading.scope: actual fragment-internal10mm SLERP, recomputed exactly with same start samples as frame_motion_metrics; no rate cap; maximum per condition

classification_rules.strip_end: 10mm window midpoint within20mm delivered fragment endpoint measured along3D strip arc
classification_rules.nipple_near: window midpoint within20mm nipple in HOME XY
classification_rules.lateral: window midpoint within20mm left or right ROI cross-section edge in HOME X
classification_rules.primary_priority: strip_end > nipple_near > lateral > interior; flags overlap
classification_rules.threshold: >=13deg actual10mm window; overlapping windows unioned per fragment

limitations: Contact footprint is the same numerical GT isotropic contact assumption as baseline, not observed pressure/contact certification.
A envelope coverage is interpolated within measured lengths; spatial loss/gain uses actual A paths only, not invented same-length A geometry.
Location classes are explicit geometric diagnostics and do not prove causality; ROI-edge distance is HOME projected for heading and negative area bins.
